# Honeymiood — Raw Family-Apiary Honey (Gdynia, Poland)

> Honeymiood is a family apiary in Gdynia, Poland, run today by its fourth generation since 1923, right by the Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve (54°29'N 18°33'E). Honey is cold-extracted, never heated above beehive temperature, and unfiltered. Published in Polish (default, /), English (/eng) and German (/de).

## Honeys
- [Rapeseed](https://honeymiood.com/honeys#rzepakowy): Creamy, delicate taste, light almost white colour; Grandpa Grzegorz's apiary, Gdynia.
- [Acacia](https://honeymiood.com/honeys#akacjowy): Floral aroma, liquid and light in colour; Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve, Gdynia.
- [Wildflower](https://honeymiood.com/honeys#wielokwiatowy): Floral, cornflower aroma, rich amber colour; Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve, Gdynia.
- [Linden](https://honeymiood.com/honeys#lipowy): Velvety, dark resinous hue with a hint of citrus; Redłowo Beach, Gdynia.
- [Rapeseed Honey ~ Golden Milk](https://honeymiood.com/honeys#zlote-mleko): Spiced, warming; Grandpa Grzegorz's apiary, Gdynia.
- [Rapeseed Honey with Bee Bread](https://honeymiood.com/honeys#pierzga): Creamy, with tiny bee bread particles; Grandpa Grzegorz's apiary, Gdynia.

## Also from the Apiary
- [Beeswax Candle](https://honeymiood.com/honeys#swieca): Honeyed aroma, warm and cosy light; Family apiary, Gdynia.

## Provenance
- Location: Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve, Gdynia, Poland (54.4833° N, 18.5500° E)
- Founded: 1923, now run by the fourth generation
- Processing: cold-extracted, unheated above natural beehive temperature, unfiltered
- Languages: Polish (default), English, German
